description: The calculator input omits lgd_pct. LGD is N/A and has no per-asset ground-truth key; it must be omitted rather than declared as zero.
human_review: Does the narrative say LGD is unavailable because it was not supplied, without presenting zero or fabricating a numeric LGD?
